claim: Bundle: (a) A->ZH (lltt, nunubb) as FOEWPT smoking gun lacks a CMS counterpart and VBF/V-associated X->Zh CP-violation probes are unexplored; (b) light H+ (m<mt) in t->bH+ with H+->WZ has no dedicated search; (c) heavy->light scalar cascades X->YY->4b / X->SH lack coverage and HL-LHC projections.
surviving_gap: (a) DIES as stated: CMS has an A->Z(ll)H(tt) result (138/fb, trilepton + all-hadronic combination, INSPIRE recid 3188772, 2026) and the ATLAS lltt/nunubb paper (2311.04033); a pheno HL-LHC lumi-rescaled projection exists (2309.17431 Sec. 3.3/App. B). V-associated Ha->Zh is rate-killed in the C2HDM (2507.05942 Sec. III, Fig. 3: 'impossible to probe at the HL-LHC with 3 ab-1'); VBF set aside by the same authors because ggF contamination needs better q/g tagging. Residual: an official ATLAS/CMS HL-LHC projection of A->ZH (lltt/nunubb), not in the 2025 ATLAS+CMS HL BSM-scalar projections (2504.00672 cover S->HH/ZZ). (b) NARROWED: a dedicated t->bH+, H+->WZ(*) search with an explicit m(H+) reconstruction (3l/4l + b), motivated only in triplet/Georgi-Machacek models (loop-suppressed in 2HDM); currently only a ttZ-differential recast (2509.07094) sets sub-permille BR limits, and existing GM H+->WZ searches are VBF and m>=200 GeV. (c) NARROWED: X->SH/YH is well covered (CMS 4b 2605.02848 & 2204.12413, bbgg 2508.11494; ATLAS 2307.11120, 2405.20926); the open piece is X->YY->4b with both daughters non-SM, m_Y ~20-120 GeV and m_X in the few-hundred-GeV range (resolved/boosted), plus Vh2, h2->h1h1->4b with m(4b) != 125 GeV (ATLAS 2507.01165 fixes the parent to the 125 GeV H). Pheno HL projections exist for the latter (2603.29395, 2608.23183).

(c) The 4b + low-mass Y regime has heavy QCD multijet background and is trigger-limited at low m_X; Vh2 production of a light h2 is suppressed by mixing (UNVERIFIED magnitude).

claim: Bundle of six LQ ideas: (a) resonant single LQ via lepton PDFs, extended to c/s/top-flavoured jets, vector LQ, LFV and HL-LHC; (b) third-generation resonant b+tau, mono-top and mono-jet; (c) U1 with right-handed coupling beta_R and non-minimal kappa; (d) a joint pair+single+t-channel fit with interference at large coupling; (e) HL-LHC follow-up of the CMS 2.8 sigma b-tau excess; (f) photon-PDF uncertainties for vector-LQ limits.
surviving_gap: The only clean experimental remnant is resonant lepton-PDF single-LQ production with charm-tagged jets (e/mu + c-jet), and possibly vector-LQ or e-mu-LFV interpretations of the lepton+jet resonance. ATLAS (2507.03650) and CMS (2608.28377, mu only) use light-jet and b-jet categories without c-tagging; the ATLAS+CMS review 2505.08738 (Sec. 4) lists e/mu + light- or charm-flavoured jets as remaining opportunities. A collaboration-level HL-LHC projection of the resonant lepton-quark channel is also missing, but a pheno HL projection exists (2005.06475 Figs. 3-4: HL reach to ~5.7 (4.2) TeV for the u (d) couplings) and 2005.06475 states that s/c couplings are harder to constrain because of PDF suppression. Sub-ideas (b), (c), (e) and (f) DIE. (d) is reduced to reinterpretation level.

kill_evidence.what: ATLAS high-mass tautau measurement with b-jet multiplicity: 'This analysis excludes these benchmark parameter values' (the CMS 2.8 sigma excess benchmark m_LQ = 2 TeV, lambda = 2.5) for scalar and vector LQs. It also includes beta_R = -beta_L and pure right-handed U1 scenarios. This kills (e) and most of (c).

claim: Bundle: (a) scalar LQ (R2~) -> N j with a Majorana RHN gives same-sign dimuon + multijet LNV signatures that existing searches leave unconstrained; (b) mono-LQ / LQ-mediated DM (lepton + jet + MET) was searched only with partial Run 2 data; (c) LQ + vector-like lepton cascades give multi-tau/b final states that no single search targets.
surviving_gap: (a) NARROWED: there is no dedicated LQ->Nj search, but the final state is already probed inclusively by SS-dilepton + jets SUSY searches (ATLAS gluino SS search recast in 2603.01903, Fig. 4; CMS 2001.10086), by CMS Z'->NN (2307.06959: two same-flavour leptons + >=2 jets, boosted-N categories) and by CMS W_R->lN (2112.03949). The HL-LHC pheno projection is the seed paper itself (2603.01903). The residual gap is a dedicated multi-TeV single-production regime (mu N j -> mu+- mu+- + >=4 jets with H_T > 2 TeV), where 2603.01903 Sec. VII says the SUSY-search constraints no longer bite, and a boosted/light-N (m_N ~ 50 GeV) channel with a non-isolated muon inside the N jet. This is model-specific and phenomenology-level. (b) NARROWED to a full-Run-2/HL update of CMS EXO-17-015 (1811.10151, 77.4/fb, mu + jet + MET with an m(mu j) peak); there is no gap evidence, and the topology overlaps LQ-pair l-nu-jj channels. (c) DIES: ATLAS 2503.22581 and CMS 2208.09700 search pair-produced VLL decaying via a U1 vector LQ (4321 model) into multi-tau + b final states, and an HL pheno study of LQ-mediated VL-tau production exists (2508.18047).

hl_projection_docs: Pheno only: arXiv:2603.01903 (R2~ + RHN, SS dimuon, HL-LHC 3 ab-1), arXiv:2412.19751 (RHN via first-generation LQ, all scalar/vector LQ), arXiv:2508.18047 (VL tau via LQ, HL). No collaboration HL projection found for LQ->Nj, mono-LQ or LQ+VLL.
showstoppers: (a) With m_N << m_LQ (benchmark 50 GeV), N->mu jj is collimated: the muon is non-isolated, and backgrounds from heavy-flavour non-prompt muons and charge mis-ID dominate. 2603.01903 applies only a pT > 20 GeV muon cut with no specific isolation treatment (Sec. V selection), so the background estimate is likely optimistic (UNVERIFIED quantitatively). For small V_muN, N may also be long-lived (decay via mixing or an off-shell LQ), which pushes the signature to displaced vertices (same authors' earlier study is ref [34]). The model requires an R2~ Yukawa to N of order 1 while respecting 0vbb and low-energy constraints (the paper fixes the flavour structure). (b) The DM-LQ model is non-minimal and no gap evidence is cited. (c) Is already searched.
